notes.title: TSG 1.2.0 IS LIVE !!!! (updates/changelog)
notes.notes:
BUGFIXES, IMPROVEMENTS and NEW STUFF.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474410/757ada7eb4f7af1b13ce0707e59a5ed1bdb9e379.png[/img]

1- Improved the save system to avoid data lost on every game update.

2 - Added at least 3 save slots to play multiple games with the same copy of The Space Garden.

3 - Changed the placement mode of trees and plants.

4 - Multiple planets sizes (From very small to extra large!!).

5 - Bug on zooming planets fixed.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474410/a8a0f8f8b1f7c94974000b0e43efe73e1403b905.png[/img]

6 - Added  STEAM TRADING CARDS, chromes and badges.

7 - Helpers can grown from babies to oldmans.

8 - Improved Universe navigation controls

9-Fixed and changed attack behaviour of the captus, also the animation.

10 - Some planets now have biomes (extra buffs or FX on fruits/trees/helpers)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474410/9ce2c5018501488fdd4413c03e1f9ed2c0229f8b.png[/img]

11 - Music sudently stop to loop (bugfix)

12 -  Added new trees

13 -  Added new plants

14 - Added new helpers

15 - Added minimap (you can use it reaching certain level in game)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474410/8b88b1d10026c68284e04f146697b048b9dcb84c.png[/img]

16 -  Helpers can be revived for free (touch the tomb stone).

17 - Keyshortcut for minimap (m) and inventory (z).

18 - Added a special end game when reach max game level.

19 - Fixed bugs with zombie helpers.

20 - Added satellites (new mechanics will be added on next updates)

21 - Improved graphics and general gameplay.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474410/05a5624901ba47366bb3837eb1f5bf4f837af240.png[/img]


<3 best regards and thanks for playing!!!!

notes.title: TSG V 1.1.0 UPDATE LIVE
notes.notes:
TSG V 1.1.0 is LIVE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

ACHIEVEMENTS
* Added 15 wonderfull achievements to enjoy the game!

SPECIAL EVENTS
* Enjoy the new special events added to the game (it’s a surprise)

BUGFIXES 
* When the game is minimized, the Unity icon is visible. Changed for TSG official icon.
* Some fruits grown over others, also some fruits doesn’t drop from trees. Fixed.
* Problems with zoom in/ zoom out on planets near to the edge. Fixed
* Info panel on the buy button shows an image of another element (for example in the Helpers).Fixed
* The game doesn’t shows any saving advice when you go to the main title screen.Fixed
* Pause the game when you unlocks game stuff. Fixed
* Music stops in strange circunstans. Fixed
* Aliens turns crazy. Fixed
* General indicators doesn’t update when you restart the game. Fixed.


IMPROVEMENTS
* Added a force save button.
* Added a pause button.
* Added SPECIAL EVENTS
* When you click a fruit that was grown to the maximun size on a tree, the fruit drops :D (no more waiting time)
* A button to see the game controls info in a popup.
* Cancel the buy process using right click.
* Changed the cancel buy icon (the new one is a red cross)
* Cancel the shovel action with right click.
* Add visual indications on interactive elements.
* Change the logic of the scrolling panel in the “Helpers/Minions” tab.
* Added a new icon to the extra stuff tab in the buy items console (in game).
* Helpers collect more fruits.
* Background with more life than the previous version.
* Fast leave game popup with Esc key (in game).
* Sound calibration.
